title: Remove distractors
question: Who first walked on the Moon, and when?
research_question: Can query-aware selection remove unrelated passages without losing the passage that contains the answer?

chunks.text: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite and orbits at an average distance of about 384,400 kilometres.
Apollo 11 landed on July 20, 1969. Neil Armstrong became the first person to step onto the lunar surface.
NASA's Artemis programme is intended to return people to the Moon using the Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft.
The Soviet Luna programme achieved the first robotic soft landing on the Moon with Luna 9 in 1966.
Moonlight is reflected sunlight, and the lunar surface has a relatively low albedo.

title: Protect exact details
